title: T-037 retrieval seam assignment
summary: Exclusive query.js and embed.js seams are assigned so T-037 can integrate hybrid retrieval without overlapping A3 or history-rewrite ownership.
evidence: T-037 owns retrieval candidate acquisition, fusion, ranking, feature-flag fallback, and rollback inside retrieveChunks() and new retrieval-only helpers in query.js.
T-037 must not change provider selection, history rewriting, or citation rendering.
T-042 exclusively owns the provider-selection branch inside answerFromContext() in embed.js and has completed that package.
T-039 exclusively owns the history-aware rewrite stage before retrieveChunks() in askQuestion() and must enter through the T-042 queue.
T-038 owns citation metadata joining and may change only publicSources() and persisted chunks_used citation fields in query.js.
T-037 and T-039 may not edit query.js concurrently, and each receipt must identify every function changed.
limitations: This seam assignment does not itself authorize T-037. Claude must review it with the T-034 and T-035 receipts and confirm the remaining enablement and latency gates.
